subject: info-doc
title: (R)INFO.DOC. ------CULT.SOLD.
description: Chart on book p. 251 (CMOA(II)-9). INFO-DOC (information documentation) is the subject, with the (R) prefix, "the reality of"; CULT-SOLD (culture solidification) is the partner, with the (P) prefix, "point of idea completion". From the subject: PROG-CONT (progressional continuance). From PROG-CONT: INT (intention), with the (R) prefix, "the reality of", and PHY-U-P (physical universe particular). From INT: AF-DY (affinity dynamics). From PHY-U-P: STF (source transfer). From AF-DY: P-FC (particular focus). From STF: MT-INFO (multi-information) and TRS (transition). From TRS: GRAD (gradualism).
